install: uv venv .venv-fw --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python .venv-fw/bin/python faster-whisper
backend_note: CTranslate2 has no Metal/MPS backend and the macOS arm64 wheel is not built with CUDA, so faster-whisper cannot touch the Apple GPU. Verified on this machine: get_cuda_device_count() == 0, get_supported_compute_types('cuda') raises ValueError('This CTranslate2 package was not compiled with CUDA support'), and CPU compute types are ['float32', 'int8', 'int8_float32'] (no float16). Observed ~460-520% CPU during the runs, i.e. it saturates several CPU cores and leaves the 60-core GPU idle. Every x_realtime below is therefore a CPU-only number and is not comparable to a Metal runner on hardware grounds; it is measured because faster-whisper is the most-cited 'fast whisper' implementation.
metric: plain CER via eval_cer.py (narration reference is complete)
timing_method: model constructed and warmed on /tmp/warm1s.wav before the timed transcribe; model_load_s and warmup_s are excluded from wall_s
decode_settings: faster-whisper defaults: beam_size=5, temperature ladder 0.0-1.0, condition_on_previous_text=True, vad_filter=False for the sequential runs. The batched run uses BatchedInferencePipeline, which forces VAD chunking.
